title: Acyclic Poset Multiplihedra and their Quotients
summary: Two families of polytopes underlie the combinatorics of associative operations. Associahedra and multiplihedra respectively capture the information in the operation itself and in the morphisms that respect that operation. The first applications of these polytopes, from Stasheff, were for modeling homotopy associative spaces and their homotopy homomorphisms. Later, lax and weak higher categories used both as the shapes of commuting diagrams. More recently, the associahedra have been generalized to versions based on graphs, and then to acyclic versions based on posets: the acyclonestohedra.…
